paite: Hiai Judah suante a-inkuan dungzui a amau a tuam dia seh a om ahi: Edom gamgi chiang, simlam pang Zin gamdai tan hial in, simtawp tanpha in akizalhsuk hi.
heading: Judah Gam Tan

paite: Simlam gamgi bel, chi Tuipi simtawp a tuipi gam geng a pan simlam doh ahi.
Simlam zuan in Akrabbim tan in apai zel a, Zin ava tung hi. Kadesh-barnea simlam ah atungkah a, Hebron ava tung a, Adar ah atoupai a, Karka akualkhum hi.
Azmon ah apai zel a, Aigupta luita ah atuakkhia a; tuipi ah gamgi atawp hi. Hiai bel simlam pang gamgi ahi.
Suahlam pang gamgi bel Chi Tuipi ahi a, Jordan ah atawp hi. Mallam pang gamgi bel tuipi tuimeng a pan Jordan tun tawp chiang ahi.
Beth-hoglah ah atoupai a, Beth-arabah mal ah apai zel a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaitou zel hi.
Akor Phaizang a pan Debir ah apaitou a, lui simlam a om Adummim atungkahna chin ah Gilgal lam zuan in mallam ah apai zel a; En-shemesh tuite ah apaipai a, En-rogel ah asuakkhia hi.

Hinam tapa phaizang ah Jebuste gam pang simlam, huai tuh Jerusalem ahi, pha in apaitou a; Hinnom tang lam pang phaizang chin a om tang vum ah apaitou a, huai tuh Rephaim mallam pang phaizang tawp mahmah ahi.
Mualvum a pan Nephtoah a luituite pha in apaisuak a, Ephron tang a khopite ah apai zel a; gamgi Baalah, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, lam ah apaisuk hi.
Baalah a pan tumlam pang ah Seir tang pha in akihekkual nawn a, mallam pang ah Jearim, huai tuh Kesalon ahi, Beth-shemesh ah apaisuk a, Timnah tawn in apai zel hi.
Mallam pang Ekron zul ah apaikhia a, Shikron ah apaisuak a, Baalah tang ah apai zel a, Jabneel ah apawt a; tuipi ah atawp hi.
Tumlam pang gamgi bel tuipi azat a za leh apiau chiang teng ahi. Huai gam chiang ahi Judah suante a dia a-inkuan uh dungzui a sehsak a om.
Jephunneh tapa Kaleb TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak bang in Judah suante lak ah tantuam abawlsak a, huai tuh Kiriath-arba ahi, Arba bel Anan pa ahi a, akhopi ahihleh Hebron ahi.
heading: Kaleb In Hebron Leh Debir Azou / (Vai 1.11-15)

paite: Kaleb in huai khua a pan Anak tapate thum Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai adelhkhia hi.
Huai a pan Debir khomite ava dou a; ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher va dou a, va la zou peuhmah, azi ding in ka tanu Aksah ka pe ding," achi hi.
Kaleb unaupa Kenaz tapa Othniel in ava la zou a; huchi in azi ding in atanu Aksah aneisakta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in, apa gam ngen ding in akuan a; asabiltung a pan akumkhia hi. Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
Ama'n, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a. Tui nak neite leng hon pe tel lai in," achi hi. Huchi in tui nak nei saknungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
Hiai ahi Judah suante nam, a-inkuan uh dungzui a agouluah uh.
heading: Judah Khopite

paite: Simlam a Edom gamgi zul a Judah suante aneih khopi hiaite ahi uh: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
Kinah, Dimonah leh Adadah;
Kadesh, Hazor leh Ithnan;
Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (huai Hazor ahi),
Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Hazar-gaddah, Hesmon, Beth-palet,
Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Bizjothjah,
Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,
Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah.
Ziklag, Madmannah leh Sansannah.
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain leh Rimmon ahi ua; khopi tengteng, akhotate uh toh sawmnih-le-kua ahi.
Phaigam lam ah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah leh Gederothaim ahi ua, akhotate uh toh khopi teng sawm-le-li ahi uh.
Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad;
Dilean, Mizpah leh Joktheel;
Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon;
Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish;
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, Makkedah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
Libnah, Ether, Ahsan,
Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
Keilah, Akzib leh Mareshah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi uh.
Ekron leh akhopite leh akhotate toh,
Ekron a pan tuipi tanpha in Ashdod zul a om tengteng, akhotate uh toh.
Ashdod leh akhopite leh akhotate: Gaza leh akhopite leh akhotate; Aigupta lui leh tuipi za leh agei chiang pha in.
Singtang gam lam ah Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
Dannah leh Kirjath-sannah, huai tuh Debir ahi,
Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim leh Gosen,
Gosen, Holon leh Giloh; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-khat ahi.
Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
Janum, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
Humtah leh Kiriath-arba, huai tuh Hebron ahi, huan Zior; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi.
Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juttah,
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
Kain, Gibeah leh Timnah; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
Maarath, Beth-anoth leh Eltekon; akhotate uh toh khopite tengteng guk ahi.
Kiriath-baal, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, leh Rabbah; akhotate uh toh khopi nih ahi.
Gamdai a Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
Chi khopi Nibshan leh En-gedi; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng guk ahi.
Jerusalem a teng Jebuste ahihleh Judah suante'n adelhkhe zou kei ua, tuni tan in Jerusalem ah Judah suante leh Jebuste atengkhawm uhi.
